gloss: to be biased; to lean toward; to be uneven

definitions.gloss: to be biased; to be partial
definitions.explanation: to favor one side unfairly; to have a one-sided view or approach

definitions.gloss: to lean; to be uneven; to be lopsided
definitions.explanation: to be physically off-center or concentrated on one side

examples.japanese: {報道|ほうどう}が{偏|かたよ}っている。
{栄養|えいよう}が{偏|かたよ}らないように{気|き}をつけている。
examples.english: I'm careful not to have an unbalanced diet.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}が{片側|かたがわ}に{偏|かたよ}っている。
examples.english: The luggage is leaning to one side.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{意見|いけん}は{保守的|ほしゅてき}な{方|ほう}に{偏|かたよ}っている。
examples.english: His opinions lean toward the conservative side.

notes:
{偏|かたよ}る means to be biased or physically uneven.

VERB FORMS:
- {偏|かたよ}る (dictionary form)
- {偏|かたよ}った (past/attributive - "biased")
- {偏|かたよ}り (noun form - "bias, unevenness")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意見|いけん}が{偏|かたよ}る (opinions are biased)
- {栄養|えいよう}が{偏|かたよ}る (nutrition is unbalanced)
- {偏|かたよ}った{見方|みかた} (biased view)
- {偏|かたよ}った{食事|しょくじ} (unbalanced diet)
- {偏|かたよ}りなく (without bias, evenly)

NOUN FORM {偏|かたよ}り:
- {偏|かたよ}りがある (there is bias)
- {偏|かたよ}りをなくす (to eliminate bias)

TRANSITIVITY:
- {偏|かたよ}る is intransitive
- {偏|かたよ}らせる is the transitive/causative form

RELATED TERMS:
- {偏見|へんけん} (prejudice, bias - noun)
- {片寄|かたよ}る (variant writing)
- {傾|かたむ}く (to lean, tilt)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday and formal contexts.
